renderCommand: cd Production/ArtSources/ArtForge && swift run -c release ArtForge VC37
notes: Separate bust drawing (not a downscale): same rig, headScale, face and costume, framed so the skin face oval is 53% of the frame width. In this tight framing the soft hat points flop down over the ears (left longer, right shorter) and the centre point folds over to the right, so all three points with their bells and the collar stay inside the frame; baton rises beside the right shoulder, clear of the face; shoulders fade out below the collar.
faceRectMethod: faceRect = rig geometry of the skin face oval (hat band to chin); cross-checked against a skin-colour pixel mask
